question.text: What does sunlight provide, and which materials does a plant use to make glucose?

attempt.answer: Sunlight provides energy. Plants use water and carbon dioxide to make glucose.

feedback.message: Let us look at the ideas your explanation shows.

targeted_explanation.text: Sunlight supplies energy. Plants use that energy to make glucose from carbon dioxide and water.

source_refs.quote: Green plants use light energy from sunlight to make glucose from carbon dioxide and water during photosynthesis.
